title: SWE-Stream: Scaling Executable Training Data for SWE Agents via Progressive Construction and Elastic Streaming

paragraphs.en: Software engineering agents have advanced rapidly, but scaling their training remains constrained by the limited availability of high-quality executable tasks. Development histories contain valuable signals for constructing such tasks, yet they often require substantial reconstruction due to incomplete environments, missing tests, and inconsistent artifacts. We present SWE-Stream, a system for scaling executable SWE training data through progressive construction and elastic streaming execution. SWE-Stream progressively validates and refines task candidates, reusing existing artifacts when possible and applying targeted completion only when necessary. An elastic scheduler asynchronously coordinates construction stages under shared resource constraints, adapting execution budgets based on observed workload demands. Using development histories from 10,728 repositories across six programming languages, SWE-Stream constructs 80,874 validated tasks and collects 118,688 successful trajectories. Fine-tuning Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 on these trajectories achieves resolve rates of 69.0%, 49.3%, and 45.42% on SWE-bench Verified, Multilingual, and Pro, respectively. In a controlled comparison with approximately matched training budgets, SWE-Stream achieves a 45.6% resolve rate on SWE-bench Verified, outperforming three existing data sources. Moreover, its streaming construction strategy improves efficiency, delivering 1.45 × \times the accepted-task throughput of batch construction and accepting 13.2% more tasks than fixed-limit streaming.
paragraphs.zh: 软件工程智能体已取得快速进步，但其训练规模的扩展仍受限于高质量可执行任务的稀缺性。 开发历史包含构建此类任务的重要信号，但由于环境不完整、测试缺失以及产物不一致等问题，通常需要大量重构。 我们提出 SWE-Stream，一个通过渐进式构建和弹性流式执行来扩展可执行软件工程训练数据的系统。 SWE-Stream 会逐步验证并优化候选任务，在可能的情况下复用现有产物，仅在必要时进行针对性补全。 弹性调度器在共享资源约束下异步协调各构建阶段，并根据实际观察到的工作负载需求动态调整执行预算。 利用来自六种编程语言、10,728 个仓库的开发历史，SWE-Stream 构建了 80,874 个验证过的任务，并收集了 118,688 条成功轨迹。 在这些轨迹上对 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 进行微调后，其在 SWE-bench Verified、Multilingual 和 Pro 上的解决率分别达到 69.0%、49.3% 和 45.42%。 在与训练预算大致相当的受控对比中，SWE-Stream 在 SWE-bench Verified 上实现了 45.6% 的解决率，优于三种现有数据源。 此外，其流式构建策略提升了效率：任务吞吐量是批量构建的 1.45 倍，且比固定限额流式方法多接受了 13.2% 的任务。

paragraphs.en: Software engineering agents solve repository-level tasks by modifying code, executing tests, and iteratively refining their solutions through feedback ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) . Training these agents requires executable tasks that combine a meaningful problem description, a reproducible environment, a reference change, and validation tests capable of distinguishing correct repairs ( Pan et al., 2025 ) . Development histories provide a natural source of such supervision, but they are rarely ready for training: dependencies may become incompatible, tests may provide insufficient coverage, and descriptions, patches, and validation artifacts may not consistently reflect the same intended behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 软件工程智能体通过修改代码、执行测试，并基于反馈迭代优化解决方案来解决仓库级别的任务（Jimenez 等，2024；Yang 等，2024；Wang 等，2025b）。 训练这些智能体需要可执行的任务，这些任务应结合有意义的問題描述、可复现的环境、参考性变更以及能够区分正确修复的验证测试（Pan 等，2025）。 开发历史为这类监督提供了天然来源，但通常尚未达到可用于训练的标准：依赖项可能变得不兼容，测试可能覆盖范围不足，而描述、补丁和验证产物也可能未能始终如一地反映相同的目标行为。

paragraphs.en: Existing efforts address this challenge from different perspectives, including synthesizing faults in controlled environments ( Yang et al., 2025b ) , enriching commit-based tasks with generated artifacts ( Jain et al., 2025 ) , and automating large-scale environment and task construction ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . These approaches expand the supply of executable SWE data, yet heterogeneous development histories still require candidate-specific reconstruction, completion, and validation. Candidates become ready for subsequent stages at different times, so cohort-wide stage barriers delay those that could otherwise advance. Their resource demands also vary, making uniform per-task limits poorly suited to some workloads. These challenges motivate a system that selectively completes and validates artifacts, advances ready candidates asynchronously, and adjusts resource limits to observed demand.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的研究从不同视角应对了这一挑战，包括在受控环境中合成故障（Yang et al., 2025b）、用生成的产物丰富基于提交的任务（Jain et al., 2025），以及自动化大规模环境与任务构建（Zhao et al., 2026）。 这些方法扩大了可执行 SWE 数据的供给，但异构的开发历史仍然需要针对每个候选项进行特定的重构、补全和验证。 候选项在不同时间准备好进入后续阶段，因此整个群体中的阶段壁垒会延迟那些本可以推进的候选项。 它们的资源需求也存在差异，使得统一的任务级限制难以适应某些工作负载。 这些挑战促使我们设计一个系统，该系统能够选择性地补全和验证产物、异步推进已就绪的候选项，并根据实际观察到的需求调整资源限制。

paragraphs.en: We introduce SWE-Stream , a system that scales executable SWE data construction through two complementary designs: progressive task construction and elastic streaming execution. From repository and PR screening through construction, it reuses available artifacts and uses stage outcomes to guide candidate advancement, targeted completion or remediation, and rejection. Meanwhile, its streaming scheduler asynchronously dispatches ready stages across candidates under a shared resource budget, allowing computation to adapt to heterogeneous repository workloads.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 SWE-Stream，一个通过两种互补设计来扩展可执行 SWE 数据构建的系统：渐进式任务构建和弹性流式执行。 从仓库和 PR 筛选到构建阶段，它重复利用可用成果，并利用各阶段的输出结果来指导候选项的推进、针对性完成或修复，以及拒绝。 同时，其流式调度器在共享资源预算下异步地将就绪阶段分配给各个候选项，使计算能够适应异构的仓库工作负载。

paragraphs.en: From 203,905 initial pull-request candidates, we obtain 80,874 accepted tasks from 10,728 repositories spanning six programming languages. The resulting dataset supports both large-scale trajectory collection and supervised fine-tuning. Experiments show that training on SWE-Stream improves software engineering agent performance, achieving 69.0%, 49.3%, and 45.42% resolve rates on SWE-bench Verified, Multilingual, and Pro, respectively. Under a controlled comparison with approximately matched training tokens, SWE-Stream achieves the strongest SWE-bench Verified performance among four data sources. Furthermore, the proposed streaming construction strategy improves data generation efficiency, reaching higher accepted-task throughput and producing more validated tasks under the same pool.
paragraphs.zh: 从 203,905 个初始拉取请求候选项中，我们从涵盖六种编程语言的 10,728 个仓库中获得了 80,874 个被接受的任务。 由此生成的数据集既支持大规模轨迹收集，也支持监督微调。 实验表明，在 SWE-Stream 上进行训练能够提升软件工程智能体的性能，在 SWE-bench Verified、Multilingual 和 Pro 测试集上分别实现了 69.0%、49.3% 和 45.42% 的解决率。 在与大致匹配的训练词元进行受控比较时，SWE-Stream 在四个数据源中取得了 SWE-bench Verified 最强的性能。 此外，所提出的流式构建策略提升了数据生成效率，在相同的数据池中实现了更高的被接受任务吞吐量，并生成了更多经过验证的任务。

paragraphs.en: We introduce SWE-Stream, a scalable system for constructing executable SWE training data that combines progressive construction with elastic streaming execution: from screening through construction, stage outcomes decide whether each candidate advances, receives targeted remediation, or is rejected.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 SWE-Stream，一个可扩展的系统，用于构建可执行的 SWE 训练数据。该系统将渐进式构建与弹性流式执行相结合：从筛选到构建的每个阶段，其结果都会决定每个候选项是继续推进、接受针对性修复，还是被拒绝。

paragraphs.en: We construct a multilingual collection of 80,874 validated SWE tasks from real development histories across six programming languages.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从六种编程语言的真实开发历史中构建了一个包含 80,874 个经过验证的 SWE 任务的多语言集合。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate that SWE-Stream improves both training utility and construction efficiency, enabling stronger SWE agent performance with more efficient data generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，SWE-Stream 同时提升了训练效用和构建效率，使得 SWE 智能体能够以更高效的数据生成方式实现更强的性能。

paragraphs.en: For each screened merged pull request (PR), SWE-Stream constructs a task at the base revision with an execution environment, reference repair patch, validation tests, issue description, and provenance records. Construction proceeds through environment reconstruction, test preparation, execution validation, issue completion, and consistency and leakage review. A streaming scheduler coordinates these stages (Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个经过筛选的合并拉取请求（PR），SWE-Stream 会在基础版本中构建一个任务，该任务包含执行环境、参考修复补丁、验证测试、问题描述和来源记录。 构建过程包括环境重建、测试准备、执行验证、问题完成以及一致性和泄漏审查。 流式调度器负责协调这些阶段（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: Rule-based checks and an LLM judge screen repositories and merged PRs. The repository judge inspects project descriptions, dependency manifests, build scripts, and test configurations for a plausible reconstruction and testing procedure. GPU, database, browser, and other service requirements are recorded and assessed against available resources rather than treated as automatic exclusions. Environment reconstruction checks executability.
paragraphs.zh: 基于规则的检查和一个 LLM 裁判会筛选仓库和已合并的拉取请求。 仓库裁判会检查项目描述、依赖项清单、构建脚本和测试配置，以确认是否存在合理的重建与测试流程。 GPU、数据库、浏览器和其他服务的需求会被记录，并与可用资源进行评估，而不是被视为自动排除项。 环境重建检查会验证可执行性。

paragraphs.en: Within retained repositories, the judge examines PR descriptions and code changes for a coherent, self-contained objective verifiable through execution. We exclude documentation-only changes, formatting-only edits, automated dependency upgrades, and PRs that bundle unrelated objectives.
paragraphs.zh: 在保留的仓库中，法官会审查 PR 描述和代码变更，以确认是否存在一个可通过执行验证的、连贯且自包含的目标。 我们不包含仅更新文档的变更、仅调整格式的编辑、自动化的依赖项升级，以及合并了无关目标的 PR。

sents.en: Within retained repositories, the judge examines PR descriptions and code changes for a coherent, self-contained objective verifiable through execution.
sents.zh: 在保留的仓库中，法官会审查 PR 描述和代码变更，以确认是否存在一个可通过执行验证的、连贯且自包含的目标。

sents.en: We exclude documentation-only changes, formatting-only edits, automated dependency upgrades, and PRs that bundle unrelated objectives.
sents.zh: 我们不包含仅更新文档的变更、仅调整格式的编辑、自动化的依赖项升级，以及合并了无关目标的 PR。

paragraphs.en: We retain each candidate’s repository identifier, base and merge commits, and full diff. The diff is separated into a repair patch for production changes and a test patch for tests and fixtures. Test directories, file names, and test-framework conventions provide an initial classification. An LLM then uses the supplied diff, PR and issue context, and test configuration to identify repair and test changes, splitting mixed hunks where reliable and flagging unrelated changes for exclusion. We discard candidates whose repair and test changes cannot be reliably separated. Execution checks and consistency review then assess whether this separation keeps repair logic out of the test patch and supports the before-and-after comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 我们保留每个候选项的仓库标识符、基础提交和合并提交，以及完整的差异。 该差异被分为用于生产环境变更的修复补丁，以及用于测试和测试数据的测试补丁。 测试目录、文件名和测试框架惯例提供了初步的分类依据。 随后，大型语言模型会利用提供的差异、拉取请求和问题上下文以及测试配置，识别修复和测试相关的变更；在可靠的情况下拆分混合的区块，并标记无关的变更以供排除。 我们无法可靠分离其修复和测试变更的候选项将被舍弃。 接着，执行检查和一致性审查将评估这种分离是否能让修复逻辑不进入测试补丁，并支持前后对比。

paragraphs.en: Linked issues are recovered from explicit references and issue-closing relations. Text preceding the first repair commit forms the original issue description; later discussion remains context for completion. Candidates without linked issues or test patches remain eligible for environment reconstruction and subsequent validation, with missing artifacts completed as needed in later stages.
paragraphs.zh: 关联问题通过显式引用和问题关闭关系进行恢复。 首次修复提交之前的文本构成原始问题描述；后续讨论则作为完成问题的上下文保留。 没有关联问题或测试补丁的候选项仍可用于环境重建和后续验证，缺失的要素将在后续阶段按需补充。

sents.en: Linked issues are recovered from explicit references and issue-closing relations.
sents.zh: 关联问题通过显式引用和问题关闭关系进行恢复。

sents.en: Text preceding the first repair commit forms the original issue description; later discussion remains context for completion.
sents.zh: 首次修复提交之前的文本构成原始问题描述；后续讨论则作为完成问题的上下文保留。

sents.en: Candidates without linked issues or test patches remain eligible for environment reconstruction and subsequent validation, with missing artifacts completed as needed in later stages.
sents.zh: 没有关联问题或测试补丁的候选项仍可用于环境重建和后续验证，缺失的要素将在后续阶段按需补充。

paragraphs.en: An environment agent reconstructs the base revision in an isolated sandbox. It selects runtimes and dependencies from version constraints, lock files, and CI configurations, runs installation, build, and test commands, resolves failures from their output, and writes a log parser. If a previously constructed Dockerfile is available for the repository, the agent adapts it after rechecking the revision’s runtime, dependencies, and build and test entry points. The agent saves a self-contained Dockerfile, execution commands, a parser, and observed test results as environment artifacts. A finalizer checks the artifacts and builds the image without either patch.
paragraphs.zh: 环境智能体在一个隔离的沙盒中重建基础版本。 它从版本约束、锁文件和 CI 配置中选择运行时和依赖项，运行安装、构建和测试命令，根据输出解决失败问题，并编写日志解析器。 如果该仓库已有先前构建的 Dockerfile，智能体在重新检查该版本的运行时、依赖项以及构建和测试入口点后，会对其进行调整。 智能体将自包含的 Dockerfile、执行命令、解析器和观察到的测试结果保存为环境产物。 最终处理程序会检查这些产物，并在不使用任何补丁的情况下构建镜像。

sents.zh: 环境智能体在一个隔离的沙盒中重建基础版本。

paragraphs.en: The test agent evaluates PR and repository tests in the reconstructed environment using the saved commands and parser. It applies the test patch, when available, and runs the selected tests with and without the repair patch. Fail-to-Pass (F2P) tests fail before the repair and pass afterward; Pass-to-Pass (P2P) tests pass in both states and check for regressions. We prioritize P2P coverage of affected modules and interfaces. If the suite provides F2P cases and relevant P2P coverage, the agent reuses it.
paragraphs.zh: 测试智能体在重构环境中使用保存的命令和解析器来评估 PR 和仓库中的测试。 如果有可用测试补丁，它会应用该补丁，并分别在有修复补丁和没有修复补丁的情况下运行所选的测试。 “失败转通过”（F2P）测试在修复前失败，修复后通过；“通过转通过”（P2P）测试在两种状态下都通过，并用于检测回归问题。 我们优先确保受影响的模块和接口的 P2P 覆盖。 如果测试套件提供了 F2P 用例和相关 P2P 覆盖，智能体将重复利用这些内容。

sents.en: The test agent evaluates PR and repository tests in the reconstructed environment using the saved commands and parser.
sents.zh: 测试智能体在重构环境中使用保存的命令和解析器来评估 PR 和仓库中的测试。

sents.en: It applies the test patch, when available, and runs the selected tests with and without the repair patch.
sents.zh: 如果有可用测试补丁，它会应用该补丁，并分别在有修复补丁和没有修复补丁的情况下运行所选的测试。

sents.zh: 我们优先确保受影响的模块和接口的 P2P 覆盖。

sents.en: If the suite provides F2P cases and relevant P2P coverage, the agent reuses it.
sents.zh: 如果测试套件提供了 F2P 用例和相关 P2P 覆盖，智能体将重复利用这些内容。

paragraphs.en: If coverage is insufficient, the agent first resolves execution or parsing errors and searches for additional repository tests. It generates cases only for remaining gaps, using the base code, issue and PR discussions, and repair patch. The agent refines generated tests through trial execution, with instructions to exercise public behavior and avoid assertions tied to the reference repair or bypasses of the code under test. New tests are saved separately; production code and the original test patch remain unchanged. We submit the complete suite, execution and parsing configuration, and per-test source records to independent validation, which determines the final F2P and P2P sets (Section 2.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 如果覆盖范围不足，智能体首先会解决执行或解析错误，并搜索仓库中的其他测试用例。 它仅针对剩余的空白生成用例，并使用基础代码、问题讨论、PR 讨论以及修复补丁。 智能体通过尝试执行来优化生成的测试用例，同时要求测试用例触发公开行为，并避免与参考修复或受测代码的绕过逻辑相关的断言。 新的测试用例会被单独保存；生产代码和原始测试补丁则保持不变。 我们将完整的测试套件、执行与解析配置以及每个测试用例的源代码记录提交给独立验证方，由其确定最终的 F2P 和 P2P 集合（第 2.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: After execution validation, the issue agent prepares a self-contained description. Deferring this step avoids generation for candidates without a valid test signal and supplies validated F2P behavior when completion is needed. If the original issue specifies the trigger conditions, observed behavior, and expected behavior, the agent removes boilerplate and irrelevant discussion while preserving its requirements. This refinement adds no facts inferred from the repair patch or validation tests.
paragraphs.zh: 执行验证后，问题智能体会准备一份自包含的描述。 推迟此步骤可避免为没有有效测试信号的候选项进行生成，并在需要完成时提供经过验证的 F2P 行为。 如果原始问题指定了触发条件、观察到的行为和预期行为，该智能体将在保留其要求的同时删除模板化和无关的讨论内容。 这种精炼不会添加任何从修复补丁或验证测试中推断出的事实。

sents.en: After execution validation, the issue agent prepares a self-contained description.
sents.zh: 执行验证后，问题智能体会准备一份自包含的描述。

paragraphs.en: For missing or incomplete issues, the agent generates a description from issue and PR discussions, the repair patch, and validated F2P results. The prompt requires supported trigger conditions and expected behavior and prohibits repair locations, solution code, and implementation instructions. Final review checks consistency and leakage. Public interface names appear only when needed to specify the task and supported by the repository and development record. These descriptions are recorded as generated artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 对于缺失或不完整的问题，智能体会根据问题与 PR 讨论、修复补丁以及经过验证的 F2P 结果生成描述。 提示要求包含受支持的触发条件和预期行为，并禁止出现修复位置、解决方案代码和实施说明。 最终审查会检查一致性和信息泄露情况。 公共接口名称仅在必要时出现，以明确任务，且需得到仓库和开发记录的支持。 这些描述会被记录为生成的产物。

sents.en: For missing or incomplete issues, the agent generates a description from issue and PR discussions, the repair patch, and validated F2P results.
sents.zh: 对于缺失或不完整的问题，智能体会根据问题与 PR 讨论、修复补丁以及经过验证的 F2P 结果生成描述。

sents.en: The prompt requires supported trigger conditions and expected behavior and prohibits repair locations, solution code, and implementation instructions.
sents.zh: 提示要求包含受支持的触发条件和预期行为，并禁止出现修复位置、解决方案代码和实施说明。

sents.en: Final review checks consistency and leakage.
sents.zh: 最终审查会检查一致性和信息泄露情况。

sents.en: Public interface names appear only when needed to specify the task and supported by the repository and development record.
sents.zh: 公共接口名称仅在必要时出现，以明确任务，且需得到仓库和开发记录的支持。

sents.en: These descriptions are recorded as generated artifacts.
sents.zh: 这些描述会被记录为生成的产物。

paragraphs.en: The validator runs the candidate tests in a fresh sandbox pair. Both sandboxes start from the same base revision and saved environment configuration and receive the same candidate tests; only the post-fix sandbox receives the repair patch. Initialization, rebuilding, testing, and parsing run in both states, with outcomes matched by test identifier. These checks determine the final F2P and P2P sets independently of the test agent’s trials.
paragraphs.zh: 验证器在新鲜的沙盒对中运行候选测试。 两个沙盒均从相同的基线版本和已保存的环境配置开始，并接收相同的候选测试；只有后处理沙盒会收到修复补丁。 初始化、重建、测试和解析在所有两种状态下执行，其结果通过测试标识符进行匹配。 这些检查独立于测试智能体的尝试，确定最终的 F2P 和 P2P 集合。

sents.en: The validator runs the candidate tests in a fresh sandbox pair.
sents.zh: 验证器在新鲜的沙盒对中运行候选测试。

sents.en: Both sandboxes start from the same base revision and saved environment configuration and receive the same candidate tests; only the post-fix sandbox receives the repair patch.
sents.zh: 两个沙盒均从相同的基线版本和已保存的环境配置开始，并接收相同的候选测试；只有后处理沙盒会收到修复补丁。

sents.en: Initialization, rebuilding, testing, and parsing run in both states, with outcomes matched by test identifier.
sents.zh: 初始化、重建、测试和解析在所有两种状态下执行，其结果通过测试标识符进行匹配。

sents.en: These checks determine the final F2P and P2P sets independently of the test agent’s trials.
sents.zh: 这些检查独立于测试智能体的尝试，确定最终的 F2P 和 P2P 集合。

paragraphs.en: A candidate passes only with at least one F2P test and P2P tests covering affected modules or interfaces. Missing or skipped test results, regressions, timeouts, and execution or parsing errors trigger a retry or return the candidate to test preparation with logs and failure diagnostics. The agent revises the tests or execution configuration before validation in fresh sandboxes. Validation stops after the first successful attempt. Each stage allows at most 3 attempts per candidate; candidates are discarded if all attempts fail.
paragraphs.zh: 候选人必须至少通过一项 F2P 测试，以及覆盖受影响模块或接口的 P2P 测试，才能通过。 缺失或跳过的测试结果、回归问题、超时，以及执行或解析错误，将触发重试，或将候选人返回测试准备阶段，并附带日志和故障诊断信息。 智能体在新鲜沙盒中进行验证前，会修改测试或执行配置。 首次成功尝试后，验证过程即停止。 每个阶段每位候选人最多允许 3 次尝试；若所有尝试均失败，则该候选人将被淘汰。

sents.zh: 候选人必须至少通过一项 F2P 测试，以及覆盖受影响模块或接口的 P2P 测试，才能通过。

sents.zh: 缺失或跳过的测试结果、回归问题、超时，以及执行或解析错误，将触发重试，或将候选人返回测试准备阶段，并附带日志和故障诊断信息。

sents.zh: 首次成功尝试后，验证过程即停止。

sents.en: Each stage allows at most 3 attempts per candidate; candidates are discarded if all attempts fail.
sents.zh: 每个阶段每位候选人最多允许 3 次尝试；若所有尝试均失败，则该候选人将被淘汰。

paragraphs.en: After issue completion, a dedicated agent reviews the description, repair and test patches, and execution logs. It checks whether the description, repair, and tests address the same requirement, whether the test patch contains repair logic, and whether F2P transitions reflect the intended behavior. It also flags requirements imposed by tests but absent from the description, and repair instructions or solution code disclosed in the description.
paragraphs.zh: 问题完成后，一个专用智能体将审查描述、修复和测试补丁以及执行日志。 它会检查描述、修复和测试是否针对同一需求，测试补丁是否包含修复逻辑，以及 F2P 转换是否反映了预期的行为。 它还会标记出测试中提出的但描述中未提及的需求，以及描述中披露的修复说明或解决方案代码。

sents.en: After issue completion, a dedicated agent reviews the description, repair and test patches, and execution logs.
sents.zh: 问题完成后，一个专用智能体将审查描述、修复和测试补丁以及执行日志。

sents.en: It checks whether the description, repair, and tests address the same requirement, whether the test patch contains repair logic, and whether F2P transitions reflect the intended behavior.
sents.zh: 它会检查描述、修复和测试是否针对同一需求，测试补丁是否包含修复逻辑，以及 F2P 转换是否反映了预期的行为。

sents.en: It also flags requirements imposed by tests but absent from the description, and repair instructions or solution code disclosed in the description.
sents.zh: 它还会标记出测试中提出的但描述中未提及的需求，以及描述中披露的修复说明或解决方案代码。

paragraphs.en: For each failed check, the agent records evidence and requests targeted revision from the responsible construction stage. Revised artifacts undergo the affected downstream checks specified in Appendix D.1 before another review; candidates are discarded after 3 failed reviews. Accepted tasks retain artifacts, validation results, provenance, and revision records. The same criteria apply to original and generated artifacts.

sents.zh: 对于每次检查失败的情况，智能体都会记录证据，并向负责的建设阶段请求有针对性的修订。

paragraphs.en: Validation determines each candidate’s next required stage, and the scheduler coordinates these stages across candidates under a shared resource budget. The scheduler maintains stage queues and dispatches ready tasks to workers under a shared CPU, memory, storage, and network budget. Stage executors run agents, build environment images, and validate execution in isolated sandboxes with access to the repository and task artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 验证环节会确定每位候选者所需的下一个阶段，而调度器则会在共享资源预算的约束下，协调这些候选者之间的各个阶段。 调度器会维护各阶段的队列，并在共享的 CPU、内存、存储和网络预算范围内，将就绪的任务分配给执行单元。 阶段执行器会运行智能体、构建环境镜像，并在能够访问代码库和任务产出的隔离沙盒中验证执行过程。

sents.en: Validation determines each candidate’s next required stage, and the scheduler coordinates these stages across candidates under a shared resource budget.
sents.zh: 验证环节会确定每位候选者所需的下一个阶段，而调度器则会在共享资源预算的约束下，协调这些候选者之间的各个阶段。

sents.en: The scheduler maintains stage queues and dispatches ready tasks to workers under a shared CPU, memory, storage, and network budget.
sents.zh: 调度器会维护各阶段的队列，并在共享的 CPU、内存、存储和网络预算范围内，将就绪的任务分配给执行单元。

sents.en: Stage executors run agents, build environment images, and validate execution in isolated sandboxes with access to the repository and task artifacts.
sents.zh: 阶段执行器会运行智能体、构建环境镜像，并在能够访问代码库和任务产出的隔离沙盒中验证执行过程。

paragraphs.en: After stage checks pass, the executor saves the outputs and enqueues only that candidate for its next required stage. There is no cohort-wide barrier: a candidate that finishes early does not wait for others still in the same stage, so candidates proceed at different rates and may occupy different stages at once—for example, one under execution validation while another is still reconstructing its environment. Each task becomes eligible for trajectory collection as soon as it passes final review. Persistent states and saved artifacts support resumption without repeating completed stages whose outputs remain valid.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段检查通过后，执行器会保存输出结果，并将仅该候选者加入其下一个必要阶段的队列。 不存在整个群体范围内的障碍：提前完成的候选者无需等待仍处于同一阶段的其他人，因此候选者以不同速度推进，并且可能同时处于不同阶段——例如，一个正在接受执行验证，而另一个仍在重建其环境。 每个任务一旦通过最终审查，便有资格进行轨迹收集。 持久状态和已保存的产物支持从中断处继续执行，无需重复已完成且输出仍然有效的阶段。

sents.en: After stage checks pass, the executor saves the outputs and enqueues only that candidate for its next required stage.
sents.zh: 阶段检查通过后，执行器会保存输出结果，并将仅该候选者加入其下一个必要阶段的队列。

sents.en: There is no cohort-wide barrier: a candidate that finishes early does not wait for others still in the same stage, so candidates proceed at different rates and may occupy different stages at once—for example, one under execution validation while another is still reconstructing its environment.
sents.zh: 不存在整个群体范围内的障碍：提前完成的候选者无需等待仍处于同一阶段的其他人，因此候选者以不同速度推进，并且可能同时处于不同阶段——例如，一个正在接受执行验证，而另一个仍在重建其环境。

sents.en: Each task becomes eligible for trajectory collection as soon as it passes final review.
sents.zh: 每个任务一旦通过最终审查，便有资格进行轨迹收集。

sents.en: Persistent states and saved artifacts support resumption without repeating completed stages whose outputs remain valid.
sents.zh: 持久状态和已保存的产物支持从中断处继续执行，无需重复已完成且输出仍然有效的阶段。

paragraphs.en: Per-sandbox limits cap CPU, memory, and storage without pre-allocating them, so sandboxes share the pool on demand. Default limits are four CPU cores, 8 GiB memory, and 16 GiB storage. After a confirmed memory-limit OOM, the scheduler retries with a higher memory limit within budget; ordinary feedback may also raise memory limits when usage stays near the cap. When a sandbox shows sustained high CPU load, it raises the repository–stage CPU limit for later tasks of that stage; update rules appear in Appendix D.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 每个沙盒的限额可限制 CPU、内存和存储的使用，而无需提前分配资源，因此沙盒可根据需求共享资源池。 默认限额为四个 CPU 核心、8 GiB 内存和 16 GiB 存储。 在确认发生内存限额导致的 OOM 后，调度器会在预算范围内尝试使用更高的内存限额；当资源使用量持续接近上限时，常规反馈机制也可能提高内存限额。 当某个沙盒出现持续的高 CPU 负载时，它会提升该阶段后续任务的仓库–阶段 CPU 限额；更新规则见附录 D.2。

sents.en: Per-sandbox limits cap CPU, memory, and storage without pre-allocating them, so sandboxes share the pool on demand.
sents.zh: 每个沙盒的限额可限制 CPU、内存和存储的使用，而无需提前分配资源，因此沙盒可根据需求共享资源池。

sents.en: Default limits are four CPU cores, 8 GiB memory, and 16 GiB storage.
sents.zh: 默认限额为四个 CPU 核心、8 GiB 内存和 16 GiB 存储。

sents.en: After a confirmed memory-limit OOM, the scheduler retries with a higher memory limit within budget; ordinary feedback may also raise memory limits when usage stays near the cap.
sents.zh: 在确认发生内存限额导致的 OOM 后，调度器会在预算范围内尝试使用更高的内存限额；当资源使用量持续接近上限时，常规反馈机制也可能提高内存限额。

sents.en: When a sandbox shows sustained high CPU load, it raises the repository–stage CPU limit for later tasks of that stage; update rules appear in Appendix D.2 .
sents.zh: 当某个沙盒出现持续的高 CPU 负载时，它会提升该阶段后续任务的仓库–阶段 CPU 限额；更新规则见附录 D.2。

paragraphs.en: Admission control keeps the system stable and robust under load. The scheduler admits new work under a slot cap and the pool’s measured free capacity, and further regulates intake using CPU, memory, and network pressure. When any of those pressures stays high, it reduces admissions and prioritizes work already in progress; intake recovers when all three ease. Appendix D.3 states the control rules.
paragraphs.zh: 准入控制可在负载条件下保持系统的稳定与健壮性。 调度器在槽位上限和池中测得的可用容量范围内接纳新任务，并进一步通过 CPU、内存和网络压力来调节任务流入量。 当上述任何一项压力持续处于高位时，系统会减少任务接纳，并优先处理已在进行中的任务；当三项压力均缓解后，任务流入量将恢复。 附录 D.3 说明了控制规则。

sents.en: Admission control keeps the system stable and robust under load.
sents.zh: 准入控制可在负载条件下保持系统的稳定与健壮性。

sents.en: The scheduler admits new work under a slot cap and the pool’s measured free capacity, and further regulates intake using CPU, memory, and network pressure.
sents.zh: 调度器在槽位上限和池中测得的可用容量范围内接纳新任务，并进一步通过 CPU、内存和网络压力来调节任务流入量。

sents.en: When any of those pressures stays high, it reduces admissions and prioritizes work already in progress; intake recovers when all three ease.
sents.zh: 当上述任何一项压力持续处于高位时，系统会减少任务接纳，并优先处理已在进行中的任务；当三项压力均缓解后，任务流入量将恢复。

sents.en: Appendix D.3 states the control rules.
sents.zh: 附录 D.3 说明了控制规则。

paragraphs.en: SWE-Stream contains 80,874 accepted tasks from 10,728 open-source repositories across Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Go, and C++, collected under licenses that permit research reuse. Table 1 reports counts and stage-specific success rates.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate large-scale training utility, compare task sources at approximately matched training-set token counts, and measure construction speed, acceptance yield, and resource use.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了大规模训练效用，在训练集词元数大致匹配的情况下比较了任务来源，并测量了构建速度、接受率和资源使用情况。

paragraphs.en: Trajectory collection uses DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 with mini-swe-agent as the teacher, and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 is the student ( Yang et al., 2025a ) . We sample up to three attempts per task and retain only trajectories whose patches pass the retained F2P and P2P tests. Training excludes evaluation benchmark repositories.

paragraphs.zh: 我们对来自已接受任务且通过教师运行验证的 118,688 条成功轨迹进行了监督微调（SFT）（表 4.1）。 我们将训练后的模型与其初始检查点以及已发布的 SWE 智能体进行比较。

paragraphs.en: We form four training sets by random sampling from SWE-smith ( Yang et al., 2025b ) , R2E-Gym ( Jain et al., 2025 ) , Scale-SWE ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , and SWE-Stream, each with approximately 160 M tokens. We use SWE-Stream’s Python subset because the other sources provide Python tasks. Trajectory collection uses the same teacher, scaffold, tools, prompts, and budget. We fine-tune a separate model on each set from the same initial checkpoint with the same hyperparameters. Trajectory counts, mean lengths, and repository counts differ (Table 4.1 ). Appendix A gives the configuration shared with large-scale training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 SWE-smith（Yang et al., 2025b）、R2E-Gym（Jain et al., 2025）、Scale-SWE（Zhao et al., 2026）和 SWE-Stream 中通过随机采样生成四个训练集，每个训练集约含 1.6 亿个词元。 我们使用 SWE-Stream 的 Python 子集，因为其他数据源也提供了 Python 任务。 轨迹收集过程使用相同的教师模型、脚手架、工具、提示词和预算。 我们对每个训练集使用相同的初始检查点和超参数，分别进行单独模型的微调。 各训练集的轨迹数量、平均长度和仓库数量存在差异（表 4.1）。 附录 A 提供了与大规模训练共享的配置信息。

paragraphs.en: Large-scale evaluation uses SWE-bench Verified (500 tasks), a human-validated Python benchmark ( Chowdhury et al., 2024 ) ; SWE-bench Multilingual (300 tasks), covering nine languages ( Yang et al., 2025b ) ; and the SWE-bench Pro public split v1 (731 tasks), featuring long-horizon multi-file tasks ( Deng et al., 2026 ) . Resolve rate is the percentage of tasks in each split whose final patches pass the benchmark tests.

paragraphs.en: We compare Batch, fixed-limit streaming (Fixed), and SWE-Stream on the same 1,000 candidates from 60 repository groups across six languages. All three share the candidate pool, 32-slot cap, 64-core / 256 GiB / 1,024 GiB pool, default per-sandbox limits in Section 2.4 , stage timeouts, stage-local retry budgets, and queue priorities (Appendix D ). Batch applies stage barriers over the full 1,000-candidate cohort, so each stage waits for all candidates before the next stage begins. Fixed and SWE-Stream dispatch ready stages asynchronously and regulate intake with pressure-based admission on CPU, memory, and network load; only SWE-Stream raises CPU and memory limits and retries confirmed memory-limit OOMs (Table D3 , Algorithm D.3 ), while Fixed keeps the default limits. Acceptance criteria are shared across the three settings.

paragraphs.en: Fine-tuning on SWE-Stream substantially strengthens the initial checkpoint on all three benchmarks, raising mean resolve rates to 69.0%, 49.3%, and 45.42% on SWE-bench Verified, Multilingual, and Pro, respectively (Table 4.1 ). The Pro result gains 42.14 percentage points over the initial checkpoint and exceeds Open-SWE-Traces by 8.6 points ( Ahmad et al., 2026 ) . It outperforms Orchard-SWE (SFT) on Verified and SWE-HERO-32B on Multilingual by 4.7 and 5.2 points ( Peng et al., 2026 ; Ludwig et al., 2026 ) . With 3B activated parameters, our MoE model reports a Verified score 3.0 points above the 72B dense OpenSWE model ( Fu et al., 2026 ) . Our SFT results exceed the reported SFT+RL scores of SWE-MeM and Granite 4.2 on all three benchmarks ( Gao et al., 2026 ; IBM Granite, 2026 ) . Published scores use their respective models and evaluation protocols. Overall, SWE-Stream supplies strong multilingual and long-horizon training signal, enabling a sparsely activated MoE with SFT alone to match or surpass several larger or RL-augmented models.
paragraphs.zh: 在 SWE-Stream 上进行微调显著提升了初始检查点在全部三项基准测试上的表现，将平均解决率分别提升至 SWE-bench Verified、Multilingual 和 Pro 上的 69.0%、49.3% 和 45.42%（表 4.1）。 Pro 的结果比初始检查点高出 42.14 个百分点，并比 Open-SWE-Traces 高出 8.6 个百分点（Ahmad 等人，2026）。 它在 Verified 基准上优于 Orchard-SWE（SFT），在 Multilingual 基准上优于 SWE-HERO-32B，分别高出 4.7 和 5.2 个百分点（Peng 等人，2026；Ludwig 等人，2026）。 在激活 3B 参数的情况下，我们的 MoE 模型在 Verified 基准上的得分比 72B 密集 OpenSWE 模型高出 3.0 个百分点（Fu 等人，2026）。 我们的 SFT 结果在所有三项基准测试上均超过了 SWE-MeM 和 Granite 4.2 所报告的 SFT+RL 得分（Gao 等人，2026；IBM Granite，2026）。 已发表的得分均基于各自模型和评估协议得出。 总体而言，SWE-Stream 提供了强大的多语言能力和长期预测的训练信号，使得仅通过 SFT 训练的稀疏激活 MoE 模型便能与多个更大规模或结合强化学习的模型相媲美甚至超越它们。

paragraphs.en: In Figure 3 a and Table 6 , Batch, Fixed, and SWE-Stream accept 588, 592, and 670 tasks. paragraphs.en: SWE-bench mines issues and merged PRs for repair tasks ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) . R2E-Gym supplements commit-derived tasks with generated descriptions and tests ( Jain et al., 2025 ) . Scale-SWE uses a sandboxed multi-agent workflow to scale verified SWE task construction across diverse repositories ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) ; SWE-rebench V2 and daVinci-Env automate construction over larger PR collections ( Badertdinov et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2026 ) . SWE-smith synthesizes faults in configured environments ( Yang et al., 2025b ) , and SWE-Mirror transfers issue scenarios across repositories ( Wang et al., 2025a ) . R2E and RePOST construct function-level harnesses ( Jain et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2025b ) , and SWE-Flow derives development tasks from unit tests ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Unlike pipelines that mainly complete artifacts then accept or discard, SWE-Stream uses validation outcomes to choose advancement, targeted remediation, or rejection.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-bench 从合并的拉取请求中挖掘问题，用于构建修复任务（Jimenez 等，2024）。 R2E-Gym 在基于提交的任务基础上，补充了生成的描述和测试用例（Jain 等，2025）。 Scale-SWE 采用沙盒化的多智能体工作流程，将经过验证的 SWE 任务构建方法扩展到多样化的代码库（Zhao 等，2026）；SWE-rebench V2 和 daVinci-Env 则能针对更大规模的拉取请求集合自动构建任务（Badertdinov 等，2026；Fu 等，2026）。 SWE-smith 在配置好的环境中合成故障（Yang 等，2025b），而 SWE-Mirror 则能将问题场景迁移到不同代码库（Wang 等，2025a）。 R2E 和 RePOST 构建了函数级别的测试框架（Jain 等，2024；Xie 等，2025b），而 SWE-Flow 则从单元测试中推导出开发任务（Zhang 等，2025）。 与那些主要先生成产物再决定接受或丢弃的流水线不同，SWE-Stream 会根据验证结果选择继续推进、进行针对性修复或拒绝。

paragraphs.en: SetUpAgent automates historical dependency setup, test execution, and parsing ( Vergopoulos et al., 2025 ) . SWE-Factory combines collaborative agents, an environment memory pool, and automated F2P validation ( Guo et al., 2026b ) ; MEnvAgent adapts previously built environments through iterative execution and verification ( Guo et al., 2026a ) . SWE-Universe combines environment construction with iterative self-verification and hacking detection ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . SWE-bench+ identifies solution leakage and weak tests ( Xue et al., 2026 ) , and Agentless reports underspecified or misleading issues ( Xia et al., 2025 ) . paragraphs.en: We present SWE-Stream, a scalable framework for constructing executable SWE training data from development histories through progressive task construction and elastic streaming execution. It yields 80,874 validated tasks across six languages; fine-tuning on its trajectories achieves 69.0%, 49.3%, and 45.42% on SWE-bench Verified, Multilingual, and Pro, and controlled experiments show stronger training utility than existing sources under comparable token budgets. Streaming construction delivers 1.45 × \times the accepted-task throughput of batch construction and accepts 13.2% more tasks than fixed-limit streaming.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SWE-Stream，这是一个可扩展的框架，能够通过渐进式任务构建和弹性流式执行，从开发历史中生成可执行的软件工程（SWE）训练数据。 该框架在六种语言中产生了 80,874 个经过验证的任务；在其轨迹上进行微调后，在 SWE-bench Verified、Multilingual 和 Pro 数据集上的准确率分别达到 69.0%、49.3% 和 45.42%，而控制实验表明，在相似的令牌预算下，其训练效用优于现有数据源。 流式构建方法实现了批处理构建方法 1.45 × \times 的已接受任务吞吐量，并且比固定限额的流式方法多接受了 13.2% 的任务。

paragraphs.en: These results suggest that scalable SWE agent training depends not only on collecting more development data, but also on building reliable systems that turn heterogeneous software histories into executable and verifiable learning experiences.

paragraphs.en: Evaluation uses the same mini-swe-agent 2.2.7 scaffold and tools as trajectory collection. Construction stages use the stage-specific prompts in Appendix B ; evaluation and trajectory collection use the scaffold’s solving prompts. Unlike collection (Table A1 ), the student is evaluated under a 256k context limit, at most 250 agent turns, and deterministic decoding. Each task gets one agent attempt per run under these settings and may submit at most one patch. Network, environment, or LLM-call timeouts and failures abort the attempt and restart it from scratch under the same decoding settings and seed, discarding any partial trajectory, at most three times; a completed restart is kept, otherwise the task stays unresolved. All tasks in each evaluation split remain in the resolve-rate denominator.

paragraphs.en: instance_id : A unique identifier linking the artifacts of one task.

paragraphs.en: repository : The GitHub repository in owner/name format.

paragraphs.en: base_commit : The pre-fix commit checked out before applying either repair or test patches.
paragraphs.zh: base_commit：在应用修复补丁或测试补丁之前检出并使用的预置提交。

paragraphs.en: merge_commit : The merge commit of the source PR, retained for traceability.
paragraphs.zh: merge_commit：源 PR 的合并提交，用于保留可追溯性。

paragraphs.en: language : The primary programming language of the repository.

paragraphs.en: problem_statement : The final self-contained issue description supplied to the coding agent after refinement or completion.
paragraphs.zh: 问题陈述：在优化或完成之后提供给编码智能体的最终自包含问题描述。

paragraphs.en: repair_patch : Reference production-code repair from the PR, excluding test changes.
paragraphs.zh: repair_patch：来自 PR 的参考生产代码修复，不包括测试变更。

paragraphs.en: original_test_patch : Developer-written test and fixture changes extracted from the source PR, when available.
paragraphs.zh: original_test_patch：从源 PR 中提取的、由开发者编写的测试和夹具变更（如适用）。

paragraphs.en: provenance : Original/generated source labels for the final description and each retained test. Its source_records entry preserves (i) the source PR’s identifiers, original title and description, base and merge commits, full diff, and timestamps; (ii) linked issue identifiers and original titles and bodies, when available; and (iii) issue and PR comments with source references and timestamps. paragraphs.en: CPU and memory pressure compare measured use with the pool’s physical capacity, not the sum of sandbox limits. Network pressure is the larger of receive and transmit rates, each normalized by the shared external link capacity. At each 30 s tick, the controller first reads the duration-weighted pressure window covering the preceding 60 s; this same window determines dispatch eligibility and updates the intake streaks. If telemetry is incomplete, dispatch and admissions pause and both streaks reset while q q is kept. Congestion holds when any of CPU, memory, or network meets or exceeds its threshold, and recovery when all three fall at or below theirs (Table D3 ); otherwise q q is unchanged. A streak resets when its condition fails or intake changes.
paragraphs.zh: CPU 和内存压力通过比较实际使用量与资源池的物理容量来评估，而非沙盒限制的总和。 网络压力取接收速率和传输速率中的较大值，且两者均基于共享的外部链路容量进行归一化。 在每个 30 秒的时间点，控制器首先读取覆盖前 60 秒的、按持续时间加权的压力窗口；同一窗口也用于确定调度资格并更新接纳连续记录。 如果遥测数据不完整，调度和接纳将暂停，且两个连续记录都会重置，但 q q 保持不变。 当 CPU、内存或网络中任意一项达到或超过其阈值时，拥堵状态持续；当三者均降至或低于各自阈值时则恢复（表 D3）；否则 q q 保持不变。 当某项连续记录的条件不再满足或接纳策略发生变化时，该记录会被重置。

paragraphs.en: Ready stages are dispatched before new candidates are admitted. Retries run first, then review, description completion, validation, test preparation, and environment reconstruction. Within a priority class, older enqueue times and task identifiers break ties, and any stage waiting at least 10 min is preferred. A stage fits when a free slot exists, measured free pool headroom remains, and the pool is not congested. Dispatch does not reserve the sandbox’s full CPU or memory limits. If the oldest aged stage still cannot fit, lower-priority dispatch waits. Sandbox CPU and memory limits are cgroup ceilings; with requests unset, sandboxes take what they need from the shared pool and concurrent limits may exceed pool capacity. 3 3 3 https://docs.kernel.org/admin-guide/cgroup-v2.html The same model holds across worker nodes that share the cluster pool. Per-attempt timeouts cover sandbox setup, rebuild, execution, and model waits, but not queueing. Attempt counters start at zero per candidate and stage, and failed-review counters per candidate; both persist through remediation and resume. Algorithm D.3 summarizes the loop.
paragraphs.zh: 在接纳新候选者之前，会先调度已就绪的阶段。 首先执行重试，随后依次进行审查、描述完成、验证、测试准备和环境重建。 在同一优先级类中，更旧的入队时间和任务标识符用于打破平局，且任何等待至少 10 分钟的阶段将被优先处理。 当存在空闲槽位、已测量的可用池剩余容量充足且池未处于拥堵状态时，一个阶段即可容纳。 调度不会预留沙盒的全部 CPU 或内存限制。 如果最旧阶段的年龄仍然无法容纳，则低优先级的调度将等待。 沙盒的 CPU 和内存限制是 cgroup 上限；若请求未设置，沙盒将从共享池中获取所需资源，且并发限制可能超过池容量。3 3 3 https://docs.kernel.org/admin-guide/cgroup-v2.html 同一模型也适用于共享集群池的所有工作节点。 每次尝试的超时时间涵盖沙盒设置、重建、执行和模型等待，但不包括排队时间。 每个候选者和阶段的尝试计数器初始值为零，每个候选者的失败审查计数器亦然；两者在修复和恢复过程中均会保留。 算法 D.3 总结了该循环。

sents.zh: 调度不会预留沙盒的全部 CPU 或内存限制。

sents.en: If the oldest aged stage still cannot fit, lower-priority dispatch waits.
sents.zh: 如果最旧阶段的年龄仍然无法容纳，则低优先级的调度将等待。

sents.en: Sandbox CPU and memory limits are cgroup ceilings; with requests unset, sandboxes take what they need from the shared pool and concurrent limits may exceed pool capacity. 3 3 3 https://docs.kernel.org/admin-guide/cgroup-v2.html The same model holds across worker nodes that share the cluster pool.
sents.zh: 沙盒的 CPU 和内存限制是 cgroup 上限；若请求未设置，沙盒将从共享池中获取所需资源，且并发限制可能超过池容量。3 3 3 https://docs.kernel.org/admin-guide/cgroup-v2.html 同一模型也适用于共享集群池的所有工作节点。

sents.en: Per-attempt timeouts cover sandbox setup, rebuild, execution, and model waits, but not queueing.
sents.zh: 每次尝试的超时时间涵盖沙盒设置、重建、执行和模型等待，但不包括排队时间。

sents.en: Attempt counters start at zero per candidate and stage, and failed-review counters per candidate; both persist through remediation and resume.
sents.zh: 每个候选者和阶段的尝试计数器初始值为零，每个候选者的失败审查计数器亦然；两者在修复和恢复过程中均会保留。

sents.en: Algorithm D.3 summarizes the loop.
sents.zh: 算法 D.3 总结了该循环。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm D.3 (continued) Admission tick. procedure AdmissionTick ⊳ \triangleright every 30 s read the pressure window for the preceding 60 s if telemetry is incomplete then reset streaks and return end if evaluate congestion and recovery from this window if the pool is not congested then dispatch ready stages in priority order while free slots and measured pool headroom remain end if update congestion and recovery streaks if congestion streak = 3 =3 then q ← ⌊ q / 2 ⌋ q\leftarrow\lfloor q/2\rfloor ; reset streak else if recovery streak = 3 =3 then q ← min ⁡ ( 8 , q + 1 ) q\leftarrow\min(8,q+1) ; reset streak end if admit up to q q new candidates within remaining slots and measured pool headroom end procedure
paragraphs.zh: 算法 D.3（续）：准入计时器。过程 AdmissionTick ⊳ \triangleright 每 30 秒读取前 60 秒的压力窗口；如果遥测数据不完整，则重置连续状态并返回；否则，基于该窗口评估拥堵和恢复情况；如果池未发生拥堵，则以优先级顺序调度就绪阶段，直到剩余空闲槽位和测得的池可用空间耗尽；更新拥堵和恢复的连续状态；如果拥堵连续计数 = 3，则 q ← ⌊ q / 2 ⌋；重置连续计数；否则，如果恢复连续计数 = 3，则 q ← min ⁡ ( 8 , q + 1 )；重置连续计数；在剩余槽位和测得的池可用空间内，接纳最多 q 个新候选者。结束过程
